text: A page script read `window.__marker` and the `.live` element on the yolo-twice session view (`/yolo-twice/34b27c?x=p1&z=t`), but it failed with "Execution context was destroyed" because the page was still navigating and its title was still "Loading". The page logged 1 console error, saved to `.playwright-mcp/console-2026-10-31T12-37-57-134Z.log` lines 1–2. No marker or live-element value was returned, so the check needs a retry after the page finishes loading.
